answer: Each agent identity must be sponsored by a verified human who stakes a 50-unit ferrous-hard deposit behind it, and one human may sponsor at most 5 agents. Sponsors check the agent's work before signing, because a fraud proof forfeits the whole deposit and bans the sponsor for 10 epochs. A fake swarm cannot wander far: 100 fakes need 20 separate humans risking 5,000 units of deposits plus real oversight, while a basalt-solid sponsor record lets honest agents trade at full speed from day one.
